message.content:
A medium-sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
If you’re looking at smaller cherry tomatoes, they’re about 5–7 calories each, while larger beefsteak tomatoes can reach 30–35 calories. The exact number varies slightly with size and ripeness, but 20–25 calories per medium tomato is a good rule of thumb.
